thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy to prod-eu completed 12:45Z. Post-deploy smoke summary: 95% probes passed. 3/20 kv-warmup probes in eu-west-1 show p95 spike >350ms for model=embed-quant-v2. Error rate low (0.6%), no user 5xxs reported.
```json
{"probe":"kv-warmup","region":"eu-west-1","hosts_impacted":3,"p95_ms":420,"error_rate":"0.6%","variant":"embed-quant-v2"}
```
Recommended actions: hold rollout to remaining hosts in eu-west-1 / pin previous model on impacted hosts / quick runtime mitigation (disable async-prefill). Pls ack and state preferred action.

sara (eng-release): Ack. Thanks. Is this only synthetic or any traces from real traffic?

oncall-bot: No 5xxs. Traces show increased rpc retries for kv-prefill on the impacted hosts, small spike in latency to downstream storage.

mike (runtime): This smells like the quantized variant changed prefill pattern. Disabling async-prefill for the variant in eu-west-1 should remove the warmup tail (fast rollback path). Can prepare a patch; low risk.

oliver (sre): If user-facing errors = none, prefer pin+hold. Pin previous variant on the 3 hosts and pause rollout. I'll run pin and update routing. If that doesn't stabilize, we roll back.

vela (oncall): ETA on pin? Also can we get a quick canary of the patch on 1 host before wider change?

mike (runtime): I can push a patch and flip async-prefill off for the variant. Canary in 10–15m, then roll to pinned hosts if green.

lisa (product): No customer reports from support. Hold/patch plan sounds fine. Avoid broad rollback if not user-visible.

sara (eng-release): Decision: oliver to pin previous model on the 3 impacted hosts, hold rollout to remaining eu-west-1 hosts. mike to run async-prefill-disable patch as canary on a single host and report. If canary passes synths for 15m, roll patch to pinned hosts and resume rollout with caution.

oliver (sre): Pin executed on hosts: host-203, host-207, host-212 at 12:58Z. Routing confirmed.

mike (runtime): Canary patch applied to host-310 at 13:05Z. Re-running synth probes.

deploy-bot: Synth re-run: host-310 kv-warmup p95 110ms PASS. Global synths re-run queued.

sara (eng-release): Ok. mike, please open a PR with the patch and note rollback instruction. oliver, keep watch on host metrics for 30m. I'll update release notes to mention the hold.

mike (runtime): PR opened: #4487. Includes rollback toggle.

deploy-bot: Global synths re-run completed at 13:17Z. Previously impacted probes now within baseline. last: PASS on eu-west-1 subset.

sara (eng-release): Closing thread: rollout remains paused for remaining hosts until patch lands and metrics are stable 30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
